studies.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Dose-escalation Phase I Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics (PK/PD) of a Single Dose of GZR18 Injection in Obese/Overweight Subjects

design.description: Sequential single-dose-escalation study of GZR18 and matched placebo.

studies.population: Chinese adults aged 18 to 65 years with BMI at least 26 kg/m2 and stable body weight.

studies.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase Ib/IIa Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Efficacy of GZR18 Injection in Chinese Obese/Overweight Patients

design.description: Two-part dose-escalation study evaluating once-weekly and once-every-two-weeks GZR18 regimens.

studies.population: Chinese adults aged 18 to 65 years with obesity, or overweight with at least one weight-related condition; Part B enrolled participants with obesity.
studies.overallDuration: Part A 26 weeks; Part B 35 weeks
studies.safetySummary: GZR18 was generally well tolerated; gastrointestinal events were mostly mild to moderate and no investigational-product-related serious adverse events were reported.

sources.title: GZR18, a GLP-1 analog with once-weekly or bi-weekly dosing for body weight management: A randomized, placebo-controlled, phase 1b/2a trial

studies.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Controlled Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of GZR18 Injection in Chinese Obese/Overweight Patients

design.description: Six-arm dose-ranging study of five bofanglutide dose/frequency regimens and pooled matched placebo.

studies.population: Chinese adults aged 18 to 75 years with obesity, or overweight with at least one weight-related comorbidity, without diabetes.
studies.safetySummary: Adverse events were mostly grade 1 or 2 gastrointestinal events. No investigational-product-related serious adverse events were reported; anti-bofanglutide antibodies occurred without neutralizing antibodies or an observed efficacy or safety impact.

sources.title: Efficacy and safety of bofanglutide, a GLP-1 receptor agonist, in Chinese adults with overweight or obesity: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2b trial

studies.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Parallel, Placebo-Controlled Phase III Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of GZR18 Injection in Adult Obese/Overweight Subjects

design.description: Three-arm trial of bofanglutide 24 mg or 48 mg every two weeks versus placebo.

studies.population: Chinese adults with obesity, or overweight with at least one weight-related comorbidity, after inadequate weight control with diet and exercise.
studies.safetySummary: Bofanglutide was generally well tolerated; the most common adverse events were predominantly mild-to-moderate and transient gastrointestinal reactions, with no new safety signals identified.

studies.officialTitle: EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF GZR18 INJECTED EVERY 2 WEEKS (Q2W) IN PARTICIPANTS WITHOUT TYPE 2 DIABETES, WHO HAVE OBESITY OR ARE OVERWEIGHT: A RANDOMIZED, TIRZEPATIDE- AND PLACEBO-CONTROLLED STUDY

design.masking: Quadruple-blind for bofanglutide and placebo; open-label tirzepatide
design.description: Dose-ranging United States trial of three bofanglutide doses, placebo and open-label tirzepatide.

studies.population: Adults aged 18 to 75 years without type 2 diabetes, with BMI at least 30 kg/m2 or at least 27 kg/m2 with a weight-related comorbidity, after inadequate weight loss with lifestyle intervention.
studies.safetySummary: The most common adverse events were gastrointestinal, including nausea, vomiting and diarrhea; events were generally mild and transient and no new safety signals were identified.

studies.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Open-Label, Parallel-Group Phase III Clinical Study Comparing the Efficacy and Safety of GZR18 Injection and Semaglutide (Wegovy) in Adult Obese or Overweight Subjects

design.description: Three-arm head-to-head trial of two bofanglutide doses and semaglutide 2.4 mg.

studies.population: Chinese adults with obesity or overweight after inadequate weight control with diet and exercise; up to 20% may have type 2 diabetes.

studies.officialTitle: A Multicenter Extension Study of the Phase 3 Clinical Study of GZR18 Injection for Weight Loss

design.description: Extension study evaluating three undisclosed once-monthly bofanglutide dose levels and placebo after prior once-every-two-weeks treatment.

studies.population: Adults who completed the qualifying original 52-week bofanglutide weight-loss study.

studies.officialTitle: BALANCE-OBS: A Multiregional, Randomized, Multicenter, Active-Controlled Confirmatory Phase III Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Bofanglutide (GZR18) Versus Semaglutide in Latin American Adults With Overweight or Obesity

design.description: Two-arm confirmatory trial of bofanglutide every two weeks versus once-weekly semaglutide.

studies.population: Latin American adults with BMI at least 30 kg/m2, or at least 27 kg/m2 with a weight-related comorbidity, without diabetes.
